dedupe_keys.name: donnees ouvertes sur les ports lacustres au togo

description: Données Ouvertes sur les Ports Lacustres au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l’Industrie et de la Promotion des Investissements . Les données sur les ports lacustres au Togo concernent les établissements portuaires situés sur les lacs, utilisés pour le transport de marchandises et de passagers. Ces ports sont essentiels pour les échanges commerciaux internes et régionaux, en particulier dans les zones proches des plans d'eau tels que le lac Togo. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l’Industrie et de la Promotion des Investissements . Its tags are lacustre, port. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
